title: The empty floor that photographs well
body: A recently vacated trophy floor. Light is good. The stack is broken. This is the picture lenders send and the picture leasing brokers fear.

title: The lobby that still works
body: Security, coffee, and a receptionist who knows names. Flight-to-quality is not abstract — it is this room.

title: The conversion guts
body: Demo, risers, and a hardhat tour. This is where office dies and housing or lab begins. Most decks skip this slide.

title: Mission Bay at 8:40am
body: People, bikes, lab badges. The only submarket that still looks like a weekday city without a narrative overlay.
